answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Work waits on the orchard until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the haven of the next round. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, unlocked only after continuous uptime. The lantern of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
